say:3:1423379001:1.text: Orlana! We've got something for you. Ravion asked us to give this letter to you personally!
say:3:1423379001:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，我们来给你送信啦。是沙利叶让我们亲手交给你的信函哦！

say:4:1423379002:1.text: From Lord Ravion...? I think I know what this is.
say:4:1423379002:1.source_cn: 是沙利叶大人托你们交给我的吗……我想，我大概知道信函的...

say:6:1423379004:1.text: If you're so curious, I'll open it and read it with you.
say:6:1423379004:1.source_cn: 好奇的话，我就打开让大家一起看看吧。

document:7:244:0.text:
Dear Miss Orlana,
In recognition of your noble character, exceptional intellect, and deep dedication to education, I, Ravion, founder of Commoners' District Elementary, am honored to extend a formal invitation for you to join us as a permanent member of our teaching faculty.
Here, you will share knowledge, spread hope, and guide these pure young minds. I believe your wisdom and patience will brighten the classroom and the children's lives.
<align="right">Ravion
document:7:244:0.source_cn:
致欧罗娜女士：
因您高尚的品格与卓越的才学，以及对教育事业的热忱，本人沙利叶，作为泽被小学的建校发起人，诚挚地向您发出邀请，决定长期聘任您为本校教师。
您将在这里分享知识、传递希望，守护这些纯真的心灵。我深信，您的智慧与耐心将点亮课堂，也点亮这些孩子的人生。
<align="right">沙利叶

say:8:1423379005:0.text: It's an offer letter! You're being invited to become the permanent teacher at the commoners' district!
say:8:1423379005:0.source_cn: 是聘任书！而且是一封邀请你长期担任泽被小学教师的聘任书！

say:9:1423379006:1.text: You must be really happy right now, Orlana!
say:9:1423379006:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你现在应该很开心吧。

say:10:1423379007:1.text: Actually, Ravion and I had talked about this before. He told me he'd send something official.
say:10:1423379007:1.source_cn: 其实，之前跟沙利叶大人谈这件事的时候，沙利叶大人就提起...

say:11:1423379008:1.text: It was my idea to add the word "permanent."
say:11:1423379008:1.source_cn: 是我主动提议他，在聘任书上加上“长期”两个字。

say:12:1423379009:1.text: I thought maybe it would ease the kind of fears Sheena once had. That I'd leave them one day...
say:12:1423379009:1.source_cn: 这样，就不会有人产生希娜产生过的担忧，怀疑我会半途而废...

say:13:1423379010:1.text: I wanted to make a promise—to the kids, and to myself as well.
say:13:1423379010:1.source_cn: 我想用这种方式向他们作出承诺，既给这些孩子信心，也给我...

say:14:1423379011:1.text: I want to be here long enough to see this school grow, to watch the children run through it with joy, and to give them the wings to go anywhere they dream of...
say:14:1423379011:1.source_cn: 我有自信用我的时间将这座学校建设得越来越好，让孩子们能...

narration:15:1423379012:1.text:
As Orlana speaks, you can almost see the school she's dreaming of.
A place where children land like birds, rest for a while, and then fly off toward their future.
And beneath it all, the school takes root, grows strong, and stretches its branches tall, becoming a great tree that will stand for years to come.
